$comment: Proposed addition to the cohort quality/rules.json (stretch bonus: new rule with precedent). Not wired into quality/check.mjs, which this repo may not edit. Same shape as the existing rules. The 'confirmed by' precedent line records the live bench run that showed grounding >= 0.95 with the fix (commit 312a139).
title: Unverified is not citable
rule: A source may carry a citation number only after its quoted snippet has been found in the same raw page text the grader fetches; a verification that failed, timed out, or has not finished yet all mean not citable.
precedent: 2026-10-01, LUMINA (team Jing0712/lumina), smoke bench: citation grounding 0.929 (13 grounded of 14 verifiable, 2 unverifiable), failing the 0.95 gate and blocking submission. Code review traced it to citable() admitting verified === null, which meant both 'publisher blocked us' and 'the verify fetch was still in flight when the answer started streaming'. In the second case the snippet came from the search provider's extract, which the raw page the bench fetches did not contain. Cost: a failed grounding gate, a code fix, and a full re-run of the bench before the deploy could be evaluated.

Confirmed by: 2026-10-05, the same deployment after the fix (commit 312a139), full bench against the deployed gateway (reports/bench.json, ranAt 2026-10-05T06:18:21Z): citation grounding 1.0 (127 grounded of 127 verifiable, 4 unverifiable, 0 dangling), passing the 0.95 gate. The two earlier runs that day on the same code also had no ungrounded citation: smoke 12 of 12, and a full bench 115 of 115 that failed on unrelated targets.
selfCheck: If your snippet-verification fetch times out, can that source still be cited in the answer? If yes, a quote nobody checked can reach the user.
